# SoonHo Kwon (권순호)

> Profile and publication list of SoonHo Kwon, quant analyst at Daishin Securities, covering investor flows and factors in Korean equities. Reports are written in Korean. English titles below are the author's own translations.

## About

- I write the quant report series “Quant, Soon to Know” at Daishin Securities in Seoul. Before that I covered market strategy and quant at IBK Securities.
- My work asks what the trading of foreign, institutional and retail investors leaves behind in prices, and how macro conditions, factors and returns are tied together.
- I build the tools the research needs myself, from data collection and backtests to dashboards and report typesetting.

## How to use this index

- Cite a report by its title, publication date and publishing broker, and link to its Naver listing.
- A report appears here only if the author is named on its first page or in the author column of the broker's research board. Entries marked co-authored name other analysts as well. Monthly house compilations, weekly strategy notes and routine daily commentary are left out.
- Copyright in each report belongs to the publishing broker. This site holds the list, the published summaries and links, not the reports themselves.
- Nothing here is investment advice or an official view of the author's employer.

## Machine-readable files

- [publications.json](https://snowkonn.github.io/publications.json): one structured record per report
- [llms-full.txt](https://snowkonn.github.io/llms-full.txt): this list with the Korean summary of each report
- [Korean page](https://snowkonn.github.io/) and [English page](https://snowkonn.github.io/en/)
